title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-4n5v: shared_vectors.rs prints name twice instead of description
description:
Severity: P3 (display regression)

`shared_vectors.rs:143` changed `vector.description` to `vector.name`, causing the test output to print the vector name twice instead of name + description:

Before: `Vector "foo" (some meaningful description; rule N): ...`
After:  `Vector "foo" (foo; rule N): ...`

The `description` field contains meaningful context about the test vector (e.g. "IPv6 ICMP echo request over CoAP"). The `name` is just a short label. Printing name twice is redundant and loses useful diagnostic info in test output.

**File:** `rust/lichen-schc/tests/shared_vectors.rs`, line 143.
